messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode of care described below. A three-character category is one capital letter followed by exactly two digits, for example J44.

Hospital course:
Hospital Course Summary:

Admission Date: [DATE]
Discharge Date: [DATE]
Admitting Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Hospital Course:
The 54-year-old male was admitted with a diagnosis of left hemisphere ischemic stroke. The patient had significant muscle atrophy resulting in limited voluntary motion in the arm and hand and severe impairment as indicated by the patient's Chedoke-McMaster Stroke Assessment hand score of 2. The patient did not exhibit any cognitive impairments.

Treatment:
The patient underwent a comprehensive treatment plan during their stay at the hospital. The treatment plan included rehabilitation sessions aimed at improving muscle strength and voluntary motion in the arm and hand. 

Outcome:
The patient's treatment plan resulted in gradual improvement in muscle strength and voluntary motion in the arm and hand. At the time of discharge, the patient's average ratio of maximum finger forces between hands was 0.076. Further follow-up sessions are recommended for continued improvement.

Follow-Up:
The patient was discharged with a comprehensive follow-up plan. The patient's progress will be monitored by the treating physician.

Reply with the three characters only.
